content_sections.heading: OAV Balangir Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download OAV Balangir Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: OAV Balangir Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Warden, 1 for Head Cook, 1 for Assistant Cook and 1 for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper.

content_sections.heading: OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All Posts: Male candidates are required for hostel application. Minimum qualification for all posts is 10th pass.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Balangir Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://balangir.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post or submit it in person.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts advertised in OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised posts are Warden, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper for the hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any specific eligibility for male candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, male candidates are specifically required for the hostel application, as mentioned in the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for all the advertised posts is 10th pass.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Balangir, which is https://balangir.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q7. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Completed applications should be sent by Registered Post / Speed Post to Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh, or submitted at the school on working days.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh, located in Balangir district, Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. What should I do if I have further questions?
faq.answer: For any further queries, it is recommended to carefully read the official notification PDF and visit the official website for any updates or clarifications.
